stem:
Read this sentence from paragraph 8.

The untouched snow bordering the pond glittered in the sun as if a million diamonds were sprinkled across its surface.

What does the author's use of imagery in this sentence emphasize?

options.label: A
options.text: Emily believes that the icy pond will be hard if she falls.

options.label: B
options.text: Emily realizes the value of learning how to ice-skate.

options.label: C
options.text: Emily thinks the snow is beautiful.

options.label: D
options.text: Emily thinks the snow is too bright.

visual_elements: The untouched snow bordering the pond glittered in the sun as if a million diamonds were sprinkled across its surface.
